record.paper_title: Variational principles in grid generation and geometric modelling: theoretical justifications and open problems
record.context_brief: Finite quasi-isometric charts for bounded-curvature manifolds
record.original_question: Does every compact two-dimensional manifold of bounded curvature without peak points admit a finite quasi-isometric chart, meaning finitely many disk-like domains with quasi-isometric flattenings, quasi-isometric coordinate changes on overlaps, and union equal to the whole manifold?

artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published resolution. The theory of two-dimensional manifolds of bounded curvature (Aleksandrov–Zalgaller) is classical, but the specific question of existence of a finite quasi-isometric atlas on compact such manifolds without peak points is posed as an open problem in expository literature on variational grid generation, and no source confirming a resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Two-dimensional manifold of bounded curvature - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Defines two-dimensional manifolds of bounded curvature via approximating Riemannian metrics with uniformly bounded total absolute curvature.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the standard background definitions but no resolution of the finite quasi-isometric chart question.

status_evidence.title: Two-Dimensional Manifolds of Bounded Curvature (Aleksandrov–Zalgaller)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational treatment of two-dimensional manifolds of bounded curvature, peak points, and local quasi-isometric coordinates.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational reference; does not assert a finite quasi-isometric chart theorem for the global compact case without peak points.
